'''Fire stew''' was a type of spicy [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Stew/Legends|stew]]<ref name="swg" /> that was [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]]<ref name="ATBPO" /> and made with [[puk]], [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Flower/Legends|flowers]], [[Water/Legends|water]], and meat.<ref name="swg" /> Around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">Fire [[Stew/Legends|stew's]] mention in "[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]" takes place a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the part of the story that is concurrent with {{Film|VI}}, the events of which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> the Ortolan [[Music/Legends|musician]] [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]] excitedly anticipated eating Fire Stew at an upcoming [[Foodstuff/Legends|dinner]]; however, he received neither the dinner nor any fire stew.<ref name="ATBPO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fire stew was first mentioned in "[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]," a short story written by [[John Gregory Betancourt]] and published in the ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]'' story collection in [[1995]].<ref name="ATBPO" /> It first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Sony]] Online Entertainment [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="swg" /> which closed in [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, it was a craftable item that gave the player boosted attributes, and like other items, it had its name fully capitalized.<ref name="swg" />
